comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: Do you need colored ores? An Amsterdam company ACME_Corporation colony in New France is offering Red Ore Blue Ore Green Ore Yellow Ore White Ore in large quantities, make sure to bring a toon with high Mineral Trading and perhaps a Alchemist Robe EX to take maximum advantage of the output. You can register the colony using "Improved_rope" toon that usually bazaars in Seville between the company office and the fountain.

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: I've recently learned that you cannot register colonies from a character with a bazaar open. I often go afk in front of Amsterdam fountain near the company office, if you want to find the alternative way.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: CaliCaddy, I was able to register another players colony while they had a bazaar open without any issue, and vice versa. It's likely these players that said they couldn't register your colony have hit the limit of the number of open colonies you can have registered (3), or they are trying to do it while at sea, or in other areas that's not in port.

comments.body: Seconding Blake, I registered for the ACME colony from a bazaar so that I can use these coloured ores for my alchemy grind a while back.
